desc.en: In the 6th month of 1st Hijri, the Prophet (s) visited the tribe of Bani Saalim which is in the north-west of Medina on invitation by Umme Bashar. As usual, he prayed two units of Zohr prayer facing Bayt-ul-Muqaddas when Allah ordered him to face Kaba. He continued the remaining prayer facing Kaba. After that, Kaba became Qiblah of Muslims forever. Hence this mosque is called ’Masjid-e-D’uqiblatan’ or ’Masjid-e-Qiblatain’ (The Mosque of Two Qiblas). This is a verse (2:144) among the verses revealed on this incident…
desc.rurdu: 1st Hijri ke 6th mahine mein, Rasool-e-Khuda (s) ne Umme Bashar ki daawat par Bani Saalim kabile ki mulaqaat ke liye gaye, jo Madina ke shimaal’e maghrib ki taraf hai. Dastur ke mutaabiq Aap (s) ne Zohr ki 2 rakat namaz qibla awwal Baitul Maqdas ki taraf rukh kar ke anjaam diya, keh us waqt Allah (swt) ka irshaad huwa keh ab se tum Kaabe ki taraf rukh kar ke namaz anjaam do. Is liye is masjid ko “Masjid Zu-qiblatain” (do qible waali masjid) kaha jaata hai. Is mauke par yeh aayat (2:144) naazil huwi thi…

arabic.text: قَدْ نَرٰى تَقَلُّبَ وَجْهِكَ فِي السَّمَاۗءِ
وَحَيْثُ مَا كُنْتُمْ فَوَلُّوْا وُجُوْهَكُمْ شَطْرَهٗ۔۔۔

lines.rarabic: QAD NARAA TA-QALLO-BA WAJHE-KA FIS SAMAAA-E, FALANO WALLE-YAN-NAAKA QIBLA-TAN TARZAA-HAA, FA-WALLE WAJHA-KA SHAT-RAL MASJE-DAL HARAAME, WA HAISO MAA KUNTUM FA-WALLOO WOJOOHA-KUM SHAT-RAHU…

trans.en: Indeed We see the turning of your face to heaven, so We shall surely turn you to a qiblah which you shall like; turn then your face towards the Sacred Mosque, and wherever you are, turn your face towards it…
trans.rurdu: Ay Rasool Ham aap ki tawajjoh ko aasmaan ki taraf dekh rahe hai to Ham an-qareeb aap ko us qible ki taraf moud denge jise aap pasand karte hai lehaaza aap apna rukh masjidul haraam ki jehat (direction) ki taraf moud dijiye aur jahan bhi rahe isi taraf rukh kijiye...
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

desc.en: Earlier there were two arches (Mehrab) opposite to each other - one facing Kaaba and another Bayt-ul-Muqaddas. Unfortunately, only one arch remained when the renovation of this mosque was done a few years ago. The first signs of this incident were erased.
desc.rurdu: Is se pehle is masjid mein 2 mehrab jo bilkul ek dusre ke muqaabil (180 digree) thay ek Kaaba ki simnt aur dusra Baitul Maqdas ki taraf. Ittefaaq se ek hi mehraab ko rakkha gaya hai aur Baitul Maqdas ki taraf ka mehraab nikaal diya gaya hai.

desc.en: Upon entering the Mosque one should perform 2 rakats namaz of respect, then recite Tasbeeh-e-Zahra (s). Recite the <Ziyarat Jame’a Kabir> and then recite this dua…
desc.rurdu: Masjid mein daakhil hone par 2 rakat namaz, ehteraame masjid ki niyyat se adaa kare. Phir Tasbeeh-e-Zahra (s) ke baad <ziyarat Jame’a Kabir> aur phir is tarah kahe…
desc.urdu: اس مسجد میں جاکر ۲ رکعت نماز تحیت مسجد پڑھے اور تسبیح فاطمہ ؑ کے بعد <زیارتِ جامعہ کبیرہ> پڑھے اور پھر یہ دعا پڑھے۔۔۔

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰہُمَّ اِنَّ ہٰذَا مَسْجِدُ الْقِبْلَتَیْنِ وَمُصَلّٰی نَبِیِّنَا وَحَبِیْبِنَا وَسَیِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّی اللہُ عَلَیْہِ وَآلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ۔ اَللّٰہُمَّ اِنَّكَ قُلْتَ وَقَوْلُكَ الْحَقُّ فِیْ كِتَابِكَ الْمُنْزَلِ عَلٰی صَدْرِ نَبِیِّكَ الْمُرْسَلِ: قَدْ نَرٰی تَقَلُّبَ وَجْہِكَ فِی السَّمَآئِ فَلَنُوَلِّیَنَّكَ قِبْلَۃً تَرْضٰیہَا فَوَلِّ وَجْہَكَ شَطْرَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA INNA HAAZAA MASJEDUL QIBLATAYNE WA MOSALLAA NABIYYENAA WA HABEEBENAA WA SAYYEDENAA MOHAMMADIN SALLAL LAAHO A’LAYHE WA AALEHI WA SALLAMA ALLAAHUMMA INNAKA QULTA WA QAWLOKAL HAQQO FEE KETAABEKAL MUNZALE A’LAA SADRE NABIYYEKAL MURSALE: ’QAD NARAA TAQALLOBA WAJHAQA FIS-SAMAAA-E FA-LA-NOWALLEYANNAKA QIBLATAN TARZAAHAA FA-WALLE WAJHAKA SHATRAL MASJEDIL HARAAME’.

trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰہُمَّ كَمَا بَلَّغْتَنَا فِی الدُّنْیَا زِیَارَتَہٗ وَمَآثِرَہُ الشَّرِیْفَۃَ فَلَا تُحْرِمْنَا یَا اَللہُ فِی الْآخِرَۃِ مِنْ فَضْلِ شَفَاعَۃِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّی اللہُ عَلَیْہِ وَآلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ وَاحْشُرْنَا فِیْ زُمْرَتِہٖ وَتَحْتَ لِوَآئِہٖ وَاَمِتْنَا عَلٰی مَحَبَّتِہٖ وَسُنَّتِہٖ وَاسْقِنَا مِنْ حَوْضِہِ الْمَوْرِدِ بِیَدِہِ الشَّرِیْفَۃِ شُرْبَۃً ہَنِیْئَۃً مَرِیْئَۃً لَا نَظْمَاُ بَعْدَہَا اَبَدًا اِنَّكَ عَلٰی كُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِیْرٌ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA KAMAA BALLAGHTANAA FID DUNYAA ZEYAARATAHU WA MAAA-SERAHUSH SHAREEFATA FALAA TOHRIMNAA YAA ALLAAHO FIL AAKHERATE MIN FAZLE SHAFAA-A’TE MOHAMMADIN SALLAL LAAHO A’LAYHE WA AALHE WA SALLAMA WAH-SHURNAA FEE ZUMRATEHI WA TAHTA LEWAAA-EHI WA AMITNAA A’LAA MAHABBATEHI WA SUNNATEHI WAS-QENAA MIN HAWZEHIL MAWREDE BE-YADEHISH SHAREEFATE SHARBATAN HANEE-ATAN MAREE-ATAN LAA TAZ-MA-O BA’DAHAA ABADAN INNAKA A’LAA KULLE SHAY-IN QADEERUN.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔

desc.rurdu: Is ke baad <Masjid-e-Fath (Ahzab)> ki ziyarat kare.
desc.urdu: اس کے بعد <مسجدِ فتح (احزاب)> کی زیارت کریں۔
